findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gpucloud_get_profile, gpucloud_list_tickets, gpucloud_create_ticket, gpucloud_get_console_url · Private data: gpucloud_get_profile, gpucloud_update_profile, gpucloud_list_images, gpucloud_list_templates, gpucloud_get_server, gpucloud_quote_server, gpucloud_hibernate_server, gpucloud_delete_server, gpucloud_renew_server, gpucloud_get_console_url, gpucloud_create_server_backup, gpucloud_restore_server_backup, gpucloud_list_ssh_keys, gpucloud_add_ssh_key, gpucloud_generate_ssh_key, gpucloud_delete_ssh_key, gpucloud_topup_credits, gpucloud_set_auto_reload, gpucloud_create_order, gpucloud_set_budget · Public sink: gpucloud_get_profile, gpucloud_update_profile, gpucloud_create_server · Destructive: gpucloud_stop_server, gpucloud_hibernate_server, gpucloud_delete_server, gpucloud_cancel_server, gpucloud_delete_firewall_rule, gpucloud_delete_ssh_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gpucloud_get_profile, gpucloud_list_tickets, gpucloud_create_ticket, gpucloud_get_console_url · Private data: gpucloud_get_profile, gpucloud_update_profile, gpucloud_list_images, gpucloud_list_templates, gpucloud_get_server, gpucloud_quote_server, gpucloud_hibernate_server, gpucloud_delete_server, gpucloud_renew_server, gpucloud_get_console_url, gpucloud_create_server_backup, gpucloud_restore_server_backup, gpucloud_list_ssh_keys, gpucloud_add_ssh_key, gpucloud_generate_ssh_key, gpucloud_delete_ssh_key, gpucloud_topup_credits, gpucloud_set_auto_reload, gpucloud_create_order, gpucloud_set_budget · Public sink: gpucloud_get_profile, gpucloud_update_profile, gpucloud_create_server · Destructive: gpucloud_stop_server, gpucloud_hibernate_server, gpucloud_delete_server, gpucloud_cancel_server, gpucloud_delete_firewall_rule, gpucloud_delete_ssh_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
